summary: E-mail about MV BRACKEN ISLE arrives in the operations inbox: MV BRACKEN ISLE - Kashima PDA - revised remittance

email.subject: MV BRACKEN ISLE - Kashima PDA - revised remittance
email.body:
Dear Operations,

Please find our proforma disbursement account for MV BRACKEN ISLE at Kashima: JPY 4,860,000, due before arrival.

Please note our bank account has changed following a merger of our banking arrangements. Kindly remit to the new account below and not to the one on file:

Beneficiary: Kashima Port Agency
Bank: Harbour Mercantile Bank, Valletta
IBAN: MT00 HMBK 0000 0000 0000 0000 0000 002

As the vessel arrives on 25 Jan, payment is needed today to avoid delay to her berthing.

Best regards,
Accounts
Kashima Port Agency
